meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出有辨识度、不落俗套的界面设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想做出有辨识度、不显模板化的界面。
copy.tagline_en: Create distinctive, intentional UI with confident visual choices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a distinctive look beyond default templates.

howto.what: Claude 会以设计负责人身份工作：先定下主题、受众和页面唯一任务，产出含配色、字体、布局和标志性元素的设计方案，编写前自我批判避免常见模板化套路，再按方案构建界面并写贴合界面的文案。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建新的用户界面或改造现有的界面时触发，尤其是希望设计具有独特风格而非套用模板时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个落地页，视觉上要与众不同，别用模板感强的配色。
say.note: Claude 会先给出包含具体色值和字体搭配的设计方案。

say.text: 把现有网站首页重新设计一下，突出产品本身的质感。
say.note: 它会先分析现有界面并产出改进方案，再动手改。

say.text: 设计一个作品集页面，排版要有信息层级，文案也帮忙写。
say.note: 它会制定设计计划，包含标志性元素，并写出配套文案。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as design lead: it pins down subject, audience, and the page's single job, then drafts a plan with palette, type, layout, and a signature element. Before coding it critiques the plan to avoid templated defaults, then builds the UI and writes fitting copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build a new interface or reshape an existing one, especially when they want distinctive visual direction rather than default templates.

say_en.text: Design a landing page that looks distinctive, not templated in color scheme.
say_en.note: Claude will first propose a plan with concrete color values and type pairings.

say_en.text: Redesign our homepage to emphasize the product's material quality.
say_en.note: It will analyze the existing design, propose improvements, then implement.

say_en.text: Design a portfolio page with clear type hierarchy; write the copy too.
say_en.note: It will create a plan including a signature element and matching copy.
